Meeting body: Dallas City Council (open microphone / public comment)
Summary: On Sept 2, 2026, comedian Alex Stein spoke during the open-microphone public comment period of a Dallas City Council meeting wearing a helmet rigged with phones and cameras. He sang a parody song, then pitched his fictional 'Flock Daddy 9900' mobile surveillance helmet, claimed it was developed with Netanyahu and Elon Musk, joked about policing women's bathrooms and classrooms, and offered a 'hometown discount.' Council members interrupted with points of order over personal remarks about Mayor Eric Johnson.
